python.purpose: Cross-platform plugin scripts using only the Python standard library

gitnexus.purpose: Supporting repository graph, process, route, trace and impact evidence when it answers a material question or an accepted gate requires it
gitnexus.appliesWhen: An accepted scope requires graph supporting evidence or GitNexus-based change-impact analysis

node.purpose: Node-based runners and target runtime verification
node.appliesWhen: A selected and authorized gate needs a Node-based runner

npm.appliesWhen: The user requests dependency installation and the target declares a compatible lockfile

codebase-onboarding.purpose: Evidence-backed project map, entry points, conventions and first-change guide

archify.purpose: Validated architecture, workflow, sequence and lifecycle diagrams
archify.appliesWhen: The user requests diagrams or accepted scope and evidence make a diagram a required deliverable

capabilityApplicabilityPolicy: Task-scoped: a capability is required only when its matching accepted gate is in scope; unused optional capabilities do not block completion.
